h1: Restaurant Oceano – Burgers and more in Schlieren
slider1: A warm welcome to Restaurant Oceano in Schlieren
slider2: Restaurant Oceano – Not just burgers in Schlieren
intro: Welcome to the website of Restaurant Oceano. With us you can enjoy traditional Portuguese cuisine and, thanks to our speciality shop, cook the dishes at home as well. And we have so much more to offer than just burgers. On these pages you can find out all the latest news about us and what we offer. We look forward to welcoming you to Restaurant Oceano!
statement: And we have so much more to offer than just burgers.
teaserKueche: Traditional Portuguese cuisine is a delight for the palate. Meat, seafood and vegetables are an integral part of it. But delicious desserts and rice dishes await you too. Get in the mood here for your visit to us at Restaurant Oceano.
teaserLaden: Portuguese specialities as far as the eye can see – that is what you will find in our shop. So you can easily cook your favourite dishes at home too. Take a look at our extensive range here. We are sure you will find what you are looking for.
teaserUeber: A new chef, a new menu, and the traditional cuisine of Portugal always at the heart of it. Find out more here about Restaurant Oceano and the team behind this delicious offering. We look forward to meeting you in person.
teaserUeberShort: A new chef, a new menu, and the traditional cuisine of Portugal always at the heart of it.
augeTitle: A feast for the eyes, too
augeText: Portuguese dishes are a pleasure for all the senses. Let our pictures take you into the world of flavour that you can enjoy to the full at Restaurant Oceano in Schlieren.
augeShort: Portuguese dishes are a pleasure for all the senses.
kuecheH2: Typical dishes from Portugal – plus burgers, snacks and more
kuecheP1: Our menu has quite a few typical Portuguese dishes to offer that will make your mouth water. Incidentally, until recently there was no official national dish. In 2011 the Portuguese were given a list of 70 different dishes to choose from.
kuecheP2: In the end, Pastéis de nata won the contest for Portugal’s national dish. But there is plenty more waiting for you here. After all, we also have burgers, snacks and other treasures on offer.
kuecheSpeisekarte: Our menu has quite a few typical Portuguese dishes to offer that will make your mouth water.
kuecheNata1: Incidentally, until recently there was no official national dish. In 2011 the Portuguese were given a list of 70 different dishes to choose from.
kuecheNata2: In the end, Pastéis de nata won the contest for Portugal’s national dish.
kuecheBurger: After all, we also have burgers, snacks and other treasures on offer.
kuecheH1: Traditional Portuguese cuisine with meat and fish in Schlieren
kuecheP3: Traditional Portuguese cuisine has something to offer for every taste. Whether fish or meat dishes, vegetables, rice or potatoes, there is something here for every guest.
kuecheFleischFisch: Whether fish or meat dishes, vegetables, rice or potatoes, there is something here for every guest.
kuecheP4: Seafood also comes in many variations, and delicious desserts are not to be missed either. At Restaurant Oceano we stick to authentic recipes that make for a treat for the palate and an experience for the senses. But the best thing is to come by and see for yourself.
kuecheMeer: Seafood also comes in many variations, and delicious desserts are not to be missed either.
kuecheRezepte: At Restaurant Oceano we stick to authentic recipes that make for a treat for the palate and an experience for the senses.
kuecheVorbei: But the best thing is to come by and see for yourself.
ladenH2: Products from Restaurant Oceano available to buy directly
ladenP1: All the products you find at Restaurant Oceano can be bought in our speciality shop. That means you can cook your favourite dishes from Portugal at home as well. Since you get everything from a single source with us, you will not have to search long for the ingredients you need.
ladenP2: We are also happy to advise you on choosing the right wine, the right quantities and spices. With us you will always find someone to talk to who can help you with expert knowledge. After all, Portuguese cuisine is our passion.
ladenH1: Portuguese specialities – salt cod and more in Schlieren
reise1: In our Portuguese speciality shop you will find the delicacies of our homeland.
reise2: Enjoy the flavours from Lisbon all the way to the Algarve, and the famous port wine.
reise3: Taste the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
reise4: Let the aromas of the Azores enchant you and, with a Licor Beirão, indulge in memories of hot summer nights.
reise5: With our specialities from Portugal, experience a journey of flavours through this many-faceted country.
ueberH1: About Portuguese food & the team at Restaurant Oceano
ueberLine: Portuguese food in Schlieren is our passion.
ueberH2: Get to know the team at Restaurant Oceano
story1: Restaurant Oceano was founded in Schlieren in 2004. From the very beginning, traditional Portuguese cuisine was at the heart of it, and that did not change when we moved to our new premises in 2010.
story2: Alongside the restaurant we run a speciality shop, thanks to which you can enjoy Portuguese food at home as well.
story3: In 2020 we renovated our restaurant and our shop, during which time the menu was also reworked by our new chef. Delicious, typically Portuguese dishes are as much our hallmark as our excellent customer service.
ueberEnd: Why not come by and get to know us? We look forward to welcoming you as our guest.
ueberEndQ: Why not come by and get to know us?
bewertungenH1: Portuguese specialities in Schlieren – what our customers say
bewertungenP1: We could spend hours telling you more about ourselves, our restaurant, our speciality shop and Portuguese cuisine in general. But in the end, what our customers say is what counts.
bewertungenP2: That is why we do not want to keep the customer reviews from you, and we would be delighted to receive your feedback too. We place great importance on first-class customer service, which is why what you say about us and what we offer matters a great deal to us.
bewertungenDanke: Thank you for being a customer of Restaurant Oceano.
shopH1: Products of Portuguese cuisine in Schlieren
shopP: In our web shop you can conveniently order ingredients and products of Portuguese cuisine online. The Restaurant Oceano team is happy to advise you if you have any questions about the specialities. If you already know what you are looking for, you can of course get started straight away.
shopLine: In our web shop you can conveniently order ingredients and products of Portuguese cuisine online.
kontaktH1: Restaurant Oceano – Takeaway and business meals in Schlieren
kontaktP: Experience the unique taste of traditional Portuguese cuisine. Whether for a family get-together, as a takeaway or for a business meal, you are warmly welcome here for any occasion. Ideally, book your table today.
